To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
We extend VAE models to collaborative filtering with text feedback.
we propose a novel VAE based model that incorporates heterogeneous priors for item recommendation.

(i) we propose a VAE model with user dependent priors for collaborative filtering with text feedback and show that this model outperforms the state-of-the-art models in terms of recommendation accuracy; (ii) we show that the proposed model is effective in incorporating both the user rating information as well as the text feedback; (iii) the proposed model is able to learn a user representation in the latent space that is able to generalize well to new users and items.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following research questions: How to effectively incorporate side information in VAEs for recommendation?
the following research questions: How can we incorporate user-dependent side information in the latent space of a VAE?
the following questions: 1) How do we extend Variational Autoencoder (VAE) models for collaborative filtering with side-information?
